tasks.label: Deploy OpenWrt Dashboard
tasks.command: scp -O openwrt/meshtest.sh root@10.10.10.1:/www/cgi-bin/ && scp -O openwrt/meshtest.sh root@10.10.10.2:/www/cgi-bin/

tasks.label: Deploy MediaMTX Config
tasks.command: scp -O mediamtx/mediamtx.yml root@10.10.10.1:/root/mediamtx/ && scp -O mediamtx/mediamtx.yml root@10.10.10.2:/root/mediamtx/

tasks.label: Deploy init.d Scripts
tasks.command: scp -O openwrt/init.d/mediamtx root@10.10.10.1:/etc/init.d/ && scp -O openwrt/init.d/mediamtx root@10.10.10.2:/etc/init.d/ && scp -O openwrt/init.d/socat root@10.10.10.1:/etc/init.d/ && scp -O openwrt/init.d/socat root@10.10.10.2:/etc/init.d/ && scp -O openwrt/socat/start-socat.sh root@10.10.10.1:/root/socat/ && scp -O openwrt/socat/start-socat.sh root@10.10.10.2:/root/socat/
